note: Rue des Pas Perdus place 2/5; landmark: level crossing: striped barrier and a tall crossing-signal post with two red lamps and a bell. The avenue crosses an old railway: the level-crossing signal is the landmark and the avenue goes on along the tracks. The duck line (suivre) is on the right lawn. No -er/-ir markers, no painted text.
